purpose: Document first-party local-registry and public map discovery plus bounded anonymous requests for Chimoio.
assessment: MOZGIS/ADE first-party national GIS infrastructure was discovered and its ArcGIS REST catalog was inspected. The exact WUP point intersects one administrative feature, but no Chimoio-specific parcel service or safe parcel geometry response was verified. The discovered parcel/talhao service is explicitly Matola municipal data.
registryAssessment: registryFound=null is appropriate: national agency prose and administrative GIS do not evidence a Chimoio-local cadastre or public parcel registry. Chimoio municipal documentation mentions land registration/cadastre procedures, but no public parcel API or viewer was verified.
